<p>What You Will Do<br>· Own product discovery and feature planning for existing internet platform products, translating user insights into user-centered product improvements.<br>· Research into and provide &nbsp;insights into global industry trends, identify emerging market opportunities, and incubate new products to explore and capture new market segments.<br>· Monitor competitor dynamics, define product positioning, roadmap and overall product strategies to maintain market competitiveness.<br>· Analyze user feedback, extract core user needs and demands, and drive the continuous iterative optimization of products.<br>· Design and iterate user growth strategies, and support cross-functional teams in product promotion and brand outreach.<br>· Track core product data metrics, formulate data-driven operational strategies, and maximize product value and market influence.<br>· Develop comprehensive product monetization strategies to drive sustainable revenue growth.</p>

jobs.content: <p>About the Role<br>We are looking for a Game Community Operations Executive to expand and manage our overseas gaming community channels. You will identify and partner with community owners and core player organisers across major platforms, design collaboration models that drive user growth, GMV and ROI, and build a scalable community resource base.<br>Key Responsibilities<br>- Expand and operate overseas game communities and community channels; continuously source new partnership resources to drive user growth, GMV and ROI.<br>- Identify and build relationships with community owners, admins, and core player organisers across Discord, Reddit, Facebook Groups, Telegram, and game forums.<br>- Design and execute partnership models — including CPS deals, exclusive offers, community events, and bot integrations — to secure long-term, stable output from partners.<br>- Plan community growth campaigns around new game launches, version updates, and trending game topics; track traffic, payment, and conversion performance.<br>- Build and maintain a community resource library and partnership SOPs; explore AI and bot tools to improve outreach and operational efficiency.<br>Requirements<br>- Bachelor's degree or above.<br>- Strong cold outreach, business communication, and relationship management skills, with a proven ability to build partnerships from scratch.<br>- Good understanding of overseas gaming community ecosystems (e.g., Discord, Reddit, Telegram, Facebook Groups, game forums).<br>- Able to use English as a working language.<br>Good to Have<br>- Experience in overseas community operations, partnerships, affiliate marketing, KOL/KOC engagement, or game operations.<br>- Existing community or partnership resources in European or North American markets.<br>- Avid gamer with strong familiarity with overseas player culture.</p>

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Specialist
jobs.content: <p>About the Role<br>We are looking for a Game Category Operations Executive to own and grow an assigned game category on our overseas game trading platform. You will drive end-to-end category operations — from trend monitoring and merchandising to campaigns and promotions — and collaborate cross-functionally to grow category transaction volume (GMV).<br>Key Responsibilities<br>- Own overall operations for an assigned game category: develop and execute operation plans covering game trend/hotspot monitoring, merchandising, campaign and promotion follow-through; coordinate with upstream and downstream partners to grow category transaction volume.<br>- Take ownership of category transaction performance; identify growth opportunities through conversion funnel analysis and market insights.<br>- Research games and their trading markets; propose operational strategies and product improvement directions.<br>- Continuously monitor and analyse operational data of live game categories to identify issues and improve the user experience.<br>- Develop a deep understanding of players' day-to-day gaming scenarios, resolve real user pain points, and uncover opportunities for trading or top-up/recharge services within these scenarios.<br>Requirements<br>- At least 1 year of experience in overseas game operations, with in-depth knowledge of at least one game genre (SLG, card games, or RPG) or pan-entertainment products, and a good grasp of industry trends.<br>- Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret operational metrics and translate them into actionable insights and optimisation plans.<br>- Solid understanding of gamer communities — able to quickly identify where player groups gather, source relevant information, and apply it to drive business growth.<br>- Innovative and self-driven, with strong learning ability, communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.<br>Good to Have<br>- Proficiency in additional foreign languages.<br>- Overseas study or work experience.</p>
